title: Using Opus 5.5 to discover a new eyewitness record of the dodo
summary: This article explores how Anthropic's Opus 5.5 AI model was used to analyze historical documents and uncovered a previously unknown eyewitness account of the dodo, the extinct flightless bird from Mauritius.
problem_solved: AI helps historians overcome information overload by efficiently scanning and analyzing historical texts to rediscover overlooked primary sources.
why_valuable: Demonstrates AI's potential to accelerate historical research and recover lost knowledge that human researchers might miss due to the sheer volume of archived documents.
